lessons.title: Chest Pain and Ischemic Heart Disease
objectives: Explain the core concepts presented in the textbook.
Identify the main manifestations and terminology in this topic.
Review the source-based classification or comparison.

contentBlocks.text: Core explanation | الشرح الأساسي

The textbook describes angina as squeezing, pressing or burning pain beneath the sternum associated with coronary narrowing due to atherosclerosis. Myocardial infarction is described as more severe and prolonged pain associated with complete coronary blockage and injury to part of the myocardium.

lessons.title: Hypertension
objectives: Explain the core concepts presented in the textbook.
Identify the main manifestations and terminology in this topic.
Review the source-based classification or comparison.

contentBlocks.text: Core explanation | الشرح الأساسي

The book defines hypertension as blood pressure of 140/90 or above on three different readings. It distinguishes primary hypertension from secondary forms associated with kidney, thyroid, adrenal, brain disorders or some medicines. Many cases have no specific symptoms.

contentBlocks.title: الخلاصة بالعربي | Key point
contentBlocks.text: يعرّف الكتاب ارتفاع ضغط الدم بقراءات 140/90 أو أكثر في ثلاث مناسبات مختلفة. ويميز بين النوع الأولي والثانوي المرتبط بأمراض الكلى أو الغدة الدرقية أو الكظرية أو المخ أو بعض الأدوية. وقد لا تظهر أعراض محددة.
Study table | جدول للمراجعة

rows: More than 90% of cases; associated with obesity, heredity, salt intake and smoking
May be related to renal, thyroid, adrenal or brain disorders, or medicines

lessons.title: Bronchial Asthma
objectives: Explain the core concepts presented in the textbook.
Identify the main manifestations and terminology in this topic.
Review the source-based classification or comparison.

contentBlocks.text: Core explanation | الشرح الأساسي

Asthma is described as recurrent breathing difficulty caused by bronchial narrowing and viscous secretions. Triggers listed include dust, feathers, animals, fungi, pollen, fumes, some foods and medicines, and exercise in children. Features include chest tightness, dyspnea, wheezing and cough.

contentBlocks.title: الخلاصة بالعربي | Key point
contentBlocks.text: يصف الكتاب الربو بأنه نوبات متكررة من صعوبة التنفس بسبب ضيق الشعب وإفرازات لزجة. ومن المثيرات الغبار والريش والحيوانات والفطريات وحبوب اللقاح والأبخرة وبعض الأطعمة والأدوية والمجهود لدى الأطفال. وتشمل المظاهر ضيق الصدر والنهجان والصفير والسعال.
Study table | جدول للمراجعة

Some foods, medicines, exercise in children
